subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should OpenClaw make this PR's cumulative accepted-attempt main-session restart-recovery fuse the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750?
rationale: The code review did not find a concrete patch bug, but the PR changes persisted recovery semantics and competes with another open implementation, so automation should not choose the long-term recovery policy by itself.

options.title: Accept this recovery contract
options.body: Land this PR after rebase and exact-head proof if maintainers accept cumulative main-session attempts until successful progress as the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Choose the competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 instead if maintainers prefer its smaller flat-field retry-budget shape after proof is supplied.

options.title: Request a policy adjustment
options.body: Keep this PR open and ask for a different threshold/window/reset policy if cumulative attempts are too aggressive for healthy slow-recovery setups.

recommendation.title: Accept this recovery contract
recommendation.body: Land this PR after rebase and exact-head proof if maintainers accept cumulative main-session attempts until successful progress as the intended upgrade behavior.
